scope: One fixture attempt against exact b960 candidate under prior authorized synthetic-QA scope. No WebKit navigation or route conclusion.

classification: Harness/setup failure. The app-discovery action did not attach to the fixture-owned update-audit PID. The empty ledger is not evidence of a route failure or pass.

Follow CURRENT V257 diagnostic boundary: prepare and launch an exact private production-ID diagnostic app with NEANTIK_PRODUCTION_DIAGNOSTIC_DATA_ROOT bound to an owner-only /private/tmp/neantik-production-diagnostic-* root; bind PID, profile lock, WebKit host, window and counters before interaction.
